problem: Existing self-improvement evaluations and Organism Graph existed separately; actionable cross-domain changes were not bound to the same tenant revision, verified outcomes, regulatory reviews and control-group evidence in a single planner.
root_cause: A cross-domain decision contract was missing at the handoff from impact graph to evidence-backed protected improvement.
fix: Compose existing Organism Graph, improvement evaluation, verified action/outcome references and Learning Compiler in one deterministic pure planner; no parallel scheduler/database.
prevention: Every cross-domain proposal must bind tenant/change/revision/policy versions.
Provider/release verified observed business and engineering outcomes are distinct from queued actions and delivery ACKs.
Review AI Act, GDPR, NIS2, security and CSRD applicability wherever dependencies demand it.
No causal uplift without a verified independent comparison and control group.
Unknown review/evidence/counterfactual stays non-promotable; proposals never imply execution.
outcome: Candidate code and regression added; only protected main merge, provider/runtime readback and independent observations can prove operational adoption.
